text: my words are swallowed up: That is, I want words to express my grief
when he hath grass?: Heb. at grass
the thing that I long for!: Heb. my expectation
to him that is afflicted: Heb. to him that melteth
they vanish: Heb. they are cut off | when it is hot: Heb. in the heat thereof | consumed: Heb. extinguished
for now ye are: Or, for now ye are like to them | nothing: Heb. not
ye overwhelm: Heb. ye cause to fall upon
evident unto you: Heb. before your face
is in it: that is, in this matter
